## Technical Expertise & Skill Matrix

### Backend & API Engineering
- **Languages**: PHP 8.x, JavaScript (ES6+), Node.js, SQL.
- **Frameworks**: Laravel (v10, v11, v12), Express.js, NestJS, Custom PHP MVC.
- **API Standards**: RESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets (real-time data streaming), Microservices Architecture.
- **Security & Auth**: JWT, OAuth2, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), SQL Injection Prevention, XSS Sanitization, Rate Limiting, SSL/TLS.

### Frontend Engineering
- **Frameworks**: React.js (v19), Next.js, Vue.js.
- **Styling & UI**: Vanilla CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap 5, Glassmorphism design system.
- **State Management & Fetching**: React Query (TanStack Query), Context API, Redux Toolkit.
- **Performance & Optimization**: Code splitting (`React.lazy`), memoization (`useMemo`, `useCallback`), dynamic SEO management (`react-helmet-async`).

### Database & Caching
- **Relational Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite (Query optimization, indexing strategies, complex joins, schema migrations).
- **NoSQL Databases**: MongoDB (Aggregation pipelines, document modeling).
- **In-Memory & Caching**: Redis (Data caching, session management, job queues, pub/sub messaging).
- **Search Engines**: Elasticsearch integration for full-text search.

### Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
- **Cloud Provider**: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, IAM, CloudFormation).
- **Containers & Orchestration**: Docker containerization, Kubernetes basic orchestration.
- **CI/CD & Automation**: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins.
- **Hosting & Deployment**: Vercel, AWS Edge, Nginx, Apache, Linux (Ubuntu/Debian) administration.

### Testing & Code Quality
- **Unit & Integration Testing**: PHPUnit, Pest PHP, Jest.
- **End-to-End Testing**: Cypress.
- **Static Analysis & Tooling**: ESLint, Prettier, Git, Postman, Vite, Webpack.
